output.explanation: The webhook endpoint trusted whatever JSON was posted to it, so anyone who found the URL could send a fake PAYMENT.CAPTURE.COMPLETED and get an order marked paid. The handler now asks PayPal's verify-webhook-signature endpoint to check the transmission headers against our webhook id, posting the event back exactly as received, and answers 400 without touching the order unless PayPal says SUCCESS.
